component.name: Overlook
component.summary: A clear view of what matters

description.p: Overlook is a beautiful, considered mail client for Linux. A familiar workspace for reading, writing, and keeping your day in view.
Thoughtfully made for Linux. Overlook by Last Refuge.

Switch accounts from the top-right account menu and enable an opt-in All Inboxes view with per-account badges and editable From addresses. Snooze emails until a preset or custom time, overlay multiple accounts in Calendar with customizable per-account colors, customize keyboard shortcuts with Outlook and Gmail presets, request standards-based RFC 8098 read receipts, and receive calendar reminders in a dedicated window.

Connect supported accounts to MCP clients with per-account grants and run Overlook headlessly. Keep mail in local folders on disk, open messages in separate windows, and customize fonts and message body appearance. Email rendering is faster, and the conversation menu can teach Focused Inbox where to place future mail.

Use Overlook on macOS with native menus and Apple Keychain. Sign in to Gmail and Microsoft with the registrations built into release packages. See sharper vector icons throughout the app. IMAP sync continues when an individual large message cannot be downloaded.

Catch up with Gmail after time away without running into Google's quota: new mail is listed first, newest first, label changes apply without downloading again, and progress survives every pause. Add accounts from a redesigned add-account page, also shown to new installs. Sync contacts with Fastmail, iCloud, Yahoo, AOL, Microsoft and any CardDAV server. Show the tray icon on Quickshell bars, and keep mail passwords in the system keyring when GTK_USE_PORTAL is set.

Sign in to Microsoft accounts, and set up iCloud Mail, Yahoo Mail, AOL Mail and Fastmail with guided app passwords. Add Proton Mail through Proton Mail Bridge. Redesign the welcome screen, polish the main mail window, and update the HTML sanitizer for a security advisory.

Add optional background running, start at login, a tray icon, and single-instance handoff. Preserve drafts on close and Quit, improve upgrade restarts, make calendar event details resizable, and update bundled SQLite to resolve a security advisory. Overlook is now licensed under MIT.
Fix the calendar event modal, which showed only its buttons instead of the event's details.
Double-click a calendar event to open its details in a modal, expand long guest lists to see everyone, and scroll the event details.
Stop half-typed recipients from failing draft sync, and keep one refused draft from holding up the others.
Create calendar events by dragging across empty time, right-click an event to edit, duplicate or delete it, and confirm before deleting an event that has guests.
Tidy the sidebar: folders sort alphabetically and nest under the Inbox in any spelling, your own folders get a collapsible section, and arrows, icons and names line up.
Add account and folder management, folder windows, persistent Undo and history, settings search, and Omarchy theme integration. Improve IMAP synchronization and folder-only mailbox support.
Fix recipient autocomplete in To, Cc and Bcc, preserve surrounding recipients when editing replies, and handle quoted contact names correctly.
